protocol.target: Production RGB rectification at the same source-size-limited resolution, then declared illumination-aware palette mixture. At failed calibration retain the frozen neural material field; none failed in this cohort.
protocol.order: Rotate methods by photo index. One serial nice-15 worker.
protocol.fitter: Current unchanged production fitter and all geometry/paper constraints; fresh grids, no reference templates.
protocol.validation: Independent exported render, image and feature checks, then editable conversion and paper/geometry checks. Review every result including failures. Low disagreement with an erroneous mask is not motif recovery.

scope: Compare only paper palette selection with the same fixed NN-assisted crop cohort. Do not claim fresh crop improvements or attribute timing differences from historical fits to the material head.
